name: Topographic Terrain
description: Animated 3D topographic layers with adjustable perspective, material, bevel and lighting.

controls.name: preset
controls.label: Preset
controls.description: Starting material, terrain and camera configuration. Explicit properties override it.

controls.name: elevation
controls.label: Relief depth (px)
controls.description: Vertical height of the 3D relief. Zero flattens the surface.

controls.name: cameraTilt
controls.label: Camera tilt (°)
controls.description: Angle from the top-down view. Increase to reveal the sides of the terraced layers.

controls.name: cameraRotation
controls.label: Camera rotation (°)
controls.description: Rotate the view around the terrain without rotating its material or grain.

controls.name: cameraZoom
controls.label: Camera zoom
controls.description: Camera magnification, independent of terrain scale and contour density.

controls.name: terraceSoftness
controls.label: Layer bevel
controls.description: Width of the smooth transitions between layers. Values above 1 blend neighboring layer edges into broader, smoother relief.

controls.name: shadowAnimation
controls.label: Shadow animation
controls.description: Use a fixed shadow color or a smooth RGB color cycle. The cycle shares visible playback with terrain motion.

controls.name: shadowCycleDuration
controls.label: Color cycle (s)
controls.description: Seconds for one complete RGB shadow cycle, independent of terrain speed. Pause, reduced motion and Speed 0 hold the color. Replay resets it to red.

controls.name: shadowColor
controls.label: Shadow color
controls.description: Color of the relief shading, independent of the material. The default follows the theme: #737373 in light mode, #9d9d9d in dark mode. Custom values persist across theme changes.

controls.name: lightingBlend
controls.label: Lighting blend
controls.description: Blend from the pure selected material with soft relief around every layer edge (0) to directional lighting (1).

controls.name: lightDirection
controls.label: Light direction (°)
controls.description: Direction of the single light over the relief. Ambient illumination keeps unlit surfaces readable.

controls.name: lightIntensity
controls.label: Light intensity
controls.description: Strength of directional lighting. Zero leaves ambient illumination and the subtle local layer shading.

controls.name: surfaceColor
controls.label: Surface color
controls.description: Base material color of the 3D layers. Terraced follows the theme with pure white or black when omitted. Explicit colors override it.

controls.name: scale
controls.label: Terrain scale (px)
controls.description: Larger values create broader hills and valleys. Independent of layer density.

controls.name: density
controls.label: Layer density
controls.description: Number of elevation levels forming the terraced layers.

controls.name: distortion
controls.label: Terrain distortion
controls.description: Terrain irregularity and the strength of its smooth elevation morph.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Terrain seed
controls.description: Reproducible terrain composition. Changing the seed creates a new map.

controls.name: lineWidth
controls.label: Line width (px)
controls.description: Thickness of optional continuous contour ink on the layer edges, in CSS pixels.

controls.name: opacity
controls.label: Line opacity
controls.description: Opacity of optional contour ink. Zero leaves the material and lighting visible.

controls.name: backgroundColor
controls.label: Background color
controls.description: Solid color behind the 3D terrain and the Canvas fallback.

controls.name: lineColor
controls.label: Contour color
controls.description: Color of optional contour ink on the layer edges.

controls.name: accentColor
controls.label: Major contour color
controls.description: Color of optional contour ink at every fourth elevation level.

controls.name: gradientDiffusion
controls.label: Gradient diffusion
controls.description: Spread the blend between neighboring elevation colors without changing the terrain geometry.

controls.name: grain
controls.label: Surface grain
controls.description: Fine white grain, cached at device resolution and fixed in screen coordinates. Textures both the surface and optional contour ink.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Terrain speed
controls.description: Rate of the elevation morph. Zero holds the current relief.

controls.name: hover
controls.label: Strength
controls.description: How far the pointer spreads the terrain horizontally, opening its layers on the ground plane. Negative values draw them in; zero disables the mouse effect.

controls.name: hoverRadius
controls.label: Radius (px)
controls.description: Radius of the spread around the pointer, on the ground, in CSS pixels.

controls.name: hoverFollow
controls.label: Follow (s)
controls.description: Time for the effect to catch up with the pointer, and to build when it enters. Higher values trail behind it.

controls.name: hoverFade
controls.label: Fade (s)
controls.description: Time for the terrain to return to normal after the pointer leaves. Entering follows the Follow time.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Paused
controls.description: Hold the current relief without resetting its animation clock.

controls.name: animateEntrance
controls.label: Animate entrance
controls.description: Fade in over 800 ms after the first complete image or frame is ready. Set false for an immediate entrance. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
